L26.falha_pt: Generaliza a partir de alguns veganos e confunde criticar uma incoerência com desprezar pessoas; quem resgata animais já aceita que eles importam

en.frase: Vegans think they're the only ones who really defend animals
formas: You look down on people who rescue dogs and cats
To you, a rescuer who eats meat is worth nothing
en.falha: Generalizes from some vegans and confuses criticizing an inconsistency with despising people; those who rescue animals already accept that animals matter

L17.falha_pt: Tu quoque e generalização: o veganismo não tem posição sobre o aborto, os dois casos têm estruturas diferentes e a incoerência de alguém não justificaria explorar animais

en.frase: Vegans defend animals, but they support abortion
formas: They cry over a chick and support killing babies
If life matters, why not the life of the fetus?
If you're against abortion, you should be vegan
en.falha: Tu quoque and generalization: veganism has no position on abortion, the two cases have different structures, and someone's inconsistency wouldn't justify exploiting animals

L20.falha_pt: Generaliza a crítica seletiva de alguns: o critério coerente critica toda morte evitável de animais, começa pela indústria e não escolhe um povo como alvo

en.frase: Vegans are racist, because they criticize Afro-Brazilian religions
formas: Attacking religious sacrifice is religious racism
en.falha: Generalizes the selective criticism of some: the consistent criterion criticizes every avoidable killing of animals, starts with the industry and doesn't pick a people as its target

L21.falha_pt: Generalização falsa: há veganos em todas as religiões, tradições inteiras ensinam a não ferir os animais e o veganismo é compatível com a fé e com a ausência de fé

formas: Vegans don't like Christians or Jesus
Veganism wants to take the place of religion
en.falha: False generalization: there are vegans in every religion, whole traditions teach not harming animals, and veganism is compatible with faith and with the absence of faith

L8.falha_pt: Rótulo no lugar de refutação: o veganismo trata de um dano a terceiros, e não da pureza de quem come, e toda moral contraria impulsos naturais

formas: Vegans want to purify the world
It's a morality against human nature
It's for people who need to feel morally superior
en.falha: A label in place of a rebuttal: veganism is about harm to third parties, not the purity of the eater, and every morality goes against natural impulses
